# Tera

> Stripe-parity pricing simulator. Send a catalog (prices, coupons, tax rates) and a customer timeline (subscribe, trial, upgrade, seats, usage, coupons, cancel); get every invoice to the cent, exactly as Stripe would bill it. All 26 golden timeline scenarios are verified against real Stripe test clocks. Tera never moves money.

Amounts are integers in the currency's minor unit (cents; yen for JPY). Dates are ISO-8601 UTC. Billing rules R1–R12 are in the PRD.

## API

- [OpenAPI document](https://tera-orpin-three.vercel.app/api/openapi.json): every endpoint and schema
- [Interactive reference](https://tera-orpin-three.vercel.app/reference)
- POST /api/simulate: `{ catalog?, timeline }` → invoices. 400 malformed, 422 rejected the way Stripe would reject it
- POST /api/migrate: price migration MRR impact, grandfathering, per-customer deltas
- GET /api/scenarios, GET /api/scenarios/{id}: golden scenarios with hand-derived expected invoices
- GET /api/parity: recorded Stripe evidence. POST /api/parity `{ scenario }` or `{ timeline, catalog? }`: live replay in a Stripe test clock (≤15 events, ≤2 years, throttled)

## MCP

- [Setup](https://tera-orpin-three.vercel.app/mcp-setup): `claude mcp add --transport http tera https://tera-orpin-three.vercel.app/api/mcp`
- Tools: simulate_timeline, plan_price_migration, list_golden_scenarios, get_golden_scenario

## Docs

- [PRD and billing rules](https://github.com/PugarHuda/tera/blob/main/docs/PRD.md)
- [Golden scenarios](https://github.com/PugarHuda/tera/blob/main/golden/scenarios.json)
